claims.claim_text: The indexed Eugene Dechelette is highly likely to be Eugène Déchelette, the French reserve officer and BCRA intelligence officer profiled by the Ordre de la Libération.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official biography supplies the rare full name, French officer status, Free French service and BCRA intelligence chronology compatible with the index's Colonel entry.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High. The rare exact name, officer status and specific Allied intelligence context align. The Box 175 personnel file has not yet been inspected.
claims.temporal_assessment: The biography dates textile employment before August 1939 mobilization, then Free French and BCRA wartime service. It does not date the OSS personnel-file relationship.
claims.match_notes: The unaccented index spelling remains primary. Accent and spacing variants are documented, not silent corrections.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High on the rare name, matching officer status and Allied intelligence context; Box 175 remains unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last documented civilian employer before wartime military service. It is not labeled the immediate pre-OSS affiliation because the later BCRA-to-OSS relationship is not established.
